title: Tech selloff trims gains; Anthropic's IPO price becomes a flashpoint
dek: Nvidia and AI-linked stocks fell as investors weigh AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks; coverage diverges on Anthropic's IPO status.
body:
Tech stocks open sharply lower and then recover some ground, but volatility leaves the sector under pressure. CNBC reports Nvidia and other AI-linked names fell as investors weighed AI spending against inflation and the prospect of higher interest rates. Stocks close well off their intraday lows, according to CNBC.

## Why it matters

The selloff forces a recalibration of risk for companies tied to AI spending and the broader tech sector. Investor concern about corporate AI investment intersects with macro factors , inflation and higher-rate expectations , that affect valuation multiples and capital allocation. How investors price ongoing AI investment will influence funding, hiring and product road maps at firms from chipmakers to AI startups.

## The details

- CNBC reports that Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell and then finished the session noticeably above their worst levels of the day. 
- CNBC says investors weighed AI spending alongside inflation and higher-rate risks when selling tech names. 
- CNBC describes Anthropic as struggling to rebound above its IPO price. 
- Investor's Business Daily reports that Anthropic jumped back above its IPO price as AI stocks rebounded , a contrasting account to CNBC's characterization.
- Specific price moves, percentages, and timing of the rebounds are not provided in the material available.

## What to watch

Watch how investors reconcile corporate AI spending plans with ongoing macro pressure from inflation and interest rates — that will determine whether this volatility is temporary or sustained. Track Anthropic's stock action in coming sessions to see which account prevails: CNBC's note of struggle versus Investor's Business Daily's report of a post-IPO rise.

Source: reporting by CNBC.
author: Kelvane Club Desk

cover.alt: Tech stocks sink but close well off the lows, Anthropic struggles to rebound above IPO price
